trial_court: Family Court, Agartala, West Tripura, Case No. T.S. (RCR) 85 of 2016
case_name: Smti Supriya Chakraborty vs Sri Avijit Choudhury
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 2012. The wife became pregnant and gave birth to a male child in 2014. After the child's birth, the husband started torturing her physically and mentally. He drove her out of their matrimonial home in April 2016. She has been living with her parents since then.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking restitution of conjugal rights must prove desertion.
legal_principles.held: The wife-petitioner has miserably failed to prove the desertion in her case against her husband-respondent and so consequently she could not succeed to establish her case for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking divorce must establish the case of different types of cruelty, including desertion.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner-husband has successfully established the case of different types of cruelty including desertion for granting decree of divorce against the respondent-wife.

outcome.final_order: The final court order is not mentioned in the provided judgment excerpt.
